perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: The September 17 Antares definitive multi-year HALEU supply contract remains the newest material primary demand signal located, adding another customer with prepayments supporting domestic enrichment expansion.

Together with the September 9 Radiant agreement and July DOE award, this supports broadening contracted demand while keeping commercial-scale production execution as the key unresolved conversion test.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: Binding customer additions and prepayments improve demand visibility but do not prove timely commercial-scale enrichment ramp, delivery qualification or unit economics.
The next decisive evidence is physical capacity expansion and qualified deliveries against the expanding contracted backlog.

unknowns: aggregate committed HALEU volume versus planned capacity

sources.use: binding HALEU demand and prepayment evidence

lineage.searchStrategy: fresh issuer-domain verification plus materially different customer-contract corroboration
